name: transact_ai
description: Autonomous commerce extension for Google Gemini. Enables natural language product discovery, live warehouse stock check, spending policy enforcement, and Razorpay test checkout.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Searches products across local merchants, quick-commerce dark stores (Blinkit, Zepto), and marketplaces (Amazon).

query.description: Product search query (e.g. '1kg Rasgulla', 'Nescafe coffee powder', 'Crocin').

max_price_inr.description: Maximum budget ceiling in Indian Rupees (INR).

tools.name: verify_order_preflight
tools.description: Performs live pre-flight check: verifies warehouse stock availability, current price, and checks user spending policy limit.

product_id.description: UUID of the product to verify.

tools.name: create_payment_order
tools.description: Initializes a Razorpay test-mode payment order and generates the customer payment checkout link URL.

product_id.description: UUID of the verified product to order.

tools.name: find_smart_alternatives
tools.description: Searches for compliant alternative products by relaxing constraints across 4 recovery dimensions (price headroom, delivery SLA extension, cross-platform switching, and category substitutes).
